The upstream repository distributes this list under **Apache License 2.0**. Its complete, unchanged licence is retained in [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).

## Modifications and distribution scope

**This project's catalogue is a transformed selection, not an unchanged copy of the upstream list.** Selected filename/link entries were parsed into bibliographic records, display titles were normalised, references were reconciled with other research, and project classifications were added. Original editorial summaries were prepared from the separately attributed source material; they are not text supplied by the file list.

This attribution covers the reused list material in selected entries of `data/public-catalog.json` and their generated catalogue, graph and dataset representations, including the prepared SQL and GitHub dataset packages. It does not assert that every catalogue entry originated in this list. The raw upstream list and its downloader code are not bundled in either branch.

Reused list material retains its applicable Apache 2.0 terms. Jason Lowe's original implementation, documentation, classifications and original editorial contributions remain under the project's [MIT licence](../../LICENSE.txt), with the third-party exclusions in [NOTICE.md](../../NOTICE.md). Neither the root MIT licence nor this attribution replaces the applicable upstream terms.

The list contains filenames and links to presentations hosted elsewhere. Its licence does **not** establish the licence of those presentations, transfer their copyright, or grant rights in products described by them. The original presentations remain subject to their respective owners' terms. This project does not redistribute the linked PDFs as part of the Git repository.

## Retain when redistributing

Include this attribution, the complete [Apache 2.0 licence](LICENSE.txt), and the applicable [project NOTICE](../../NOTICE.md) with separately redistributed catalogue or dataset packages. Retain applicable upstream notices and prominently identify further modifications to reused material. If a later upstream revision introduces an applicable NOTICE file or other attribution, review and retain it when updating the source version.

See the [catalogue learning guide](../../docs/public-research-catalog.md) for how source metadata, access checks, graph relationships and editorial summaries are distinguished. This attribution does not imply endorsement by Connor McDonald, Oracle or the Apache Software Foundation.
